scope: Certified conservative availability dates for ECB euro-area negotiated wage growth quarterly observations; intended for PIT research only.
pit_policy: Use first value certified as available by an official ECB-dated source.
Do not replace prior vintage values with later revisions in historical checkpoints.
Certified availability dates are conservative and may be later than the true first release; this avoids look-ahead at the cost of delayed activation.

revision_evidence.interpretation: Revision detected. Historical checkpoints must retain 3.0 until the later 2.9 vintage becomes available; current revised history must not be backfilled retrospectively.

current_use.reason: Nine certified quarterly observations are enough for a narrow diagnostic but not enough to claim a statistically robust standalone wage-mediated EUR edge.

next_test: Combine PIT EUR labour, PIT HICP Services and certified negotiated-wage vintages in a reaction-function-aware diagnostic; report direct labour vs labour->services vs labour->wages->services without tuning.
